name: workspace
description: Working profile. Delivery and destructive commands stay denied; the deny baseline is reduced for normal workspace tooling. Masks are identical to restricted: credentials and host state never become writable or readable.
writable_note: Adapter-supplied at compose time (opts.writableRoots, e.g. the repo root plus a scratch directory); this file never declares writable roots.

masks.why: runner trust store (counters, breaker, lock, approval stamps) must be invisible to the sandbox
global git config (url.insteadOf, credential.helper, core.sshCommand levers)
host state: seeded read-only from the runner snapshot, never writable-bound
host state: model-provider auth readable by design, scratch state ephemeral
